🔥 Fire / Smoke

  • 1
    Activate the nearest Fire Pull Box (see the evacuation map posted on your floor for exact location — separate from a security panic button, which is confirmed not present). Do not fight the fire unless trained and it is small and safe to do so.
  • 2
    Call Fire Brigade: 18 (or 112)
  • 3
    Notify RSOC: +972 74-723-6000 | Emily Garfen: +33 6 86 31 78 71 | Julien Demouth (Site Leader)
  • 4
    Evacuate via the nearest safe exit – no elevator | The 8-person SST team sweeps the floor, last to leave
  • 5
    Assemble at Place Samuel de Champlain | Headcount | Report missing persons
  • 6
    Do not re-enter until explicit clearance from the Fire Brigade
Fire extinguishers & First Aid Kit: confirmed present, regularly checked (SICLI / EDDERIS) — exact positions are on the evacuation map posted on the floor (location-dependent, so not reproduced here — see Assembly Area Map card for the general approach).

🚑 Medical Emergency

  • 1
    Call SAMU: 15 | European Emergency: 112 — provide location: Le Colisée, Bâtiment B, 6th floor, 10 avenue de l'Arche, Courbevoie
  • 2
    Notify Emily Garfen: +33 6 86 31 78 71 | any of the 8-person SST team | Julien Demouth (Site Leader)
  • 3
    Retrieve the First Aid Kit — location shown on the evacuation map posted on the floor
  • 4
    Secure the area – keep bystanders away
  • 5
    Do not move the casualty without training
  • 6
    Post someone at the building entrance to direct the ambulance crew to the 6th floor
❤️‍🩹
First Aid Kit & SST-trained first aiders
8-person SST team, retrained 22–23 Jun 2026 — Emily Garfen (+33 6 86 31 78 71), Mahmoud EL GHOMARI (+33 6 86 62 71 26), Kerian Allaire (+33 6 73 70 58 94), Jeremy Wietrzykowski (+33 7 82 88 94 75), Alex Hamelin (+33 6 73 29 63 60), Johan Lagrand (+33 6 07 91 37 89), Hadi Temmar (+33 6 03 37 68 83), Mireille Fares (+33 6 75 65 51 78). If alone, dial 112.

🔫 Security Incident / Workplace Violence – Run · Hide · Fight

📞 Office has no landline — all internal calls route via the Office Manager's mobile: +33 6 86 31 78 71
  • 1
    RUN – Evacuate the area immediately, leave belongings behind
  • 2
    HIDE – If you cannot run: proceed to the shelter-in-place point — Primary: Louvres board room, or Alternate: the Lounge + 2 small conference rooms. Lock/barricade the door, turn off lights, stay low and silent.
  • 3
    FIGHT – Only as a last resort, use any available means
  • 4
    Call Police: 17 (or 112) | Notify RSOC: +972 74-723-6000 | Contact ISIS Sécurité (24/7): +33 1 43 33 67 55
  • 5
    Do not attempt solo rescue – wait for security forces, do not open doors until Police confirm the building is clear
🚫 Confirmed: there is no panic button on site.

🎒 Bomb Threat / Suspicious Package

Flagged as a relevant local risk for this site, per the site risk assessment.
  • 1
    Suspicious package: indicators include protruding wires, grease stains, or rigid/bulky envelopes. Do NOT touch, move, or open it.
  • 2
    Phone threat: do not hang up. Note the exact wording and any background noise if it is safe to do so.
  • 3
    Isolate the area and calmly evacuate via the nearest exit — do not use mobile phones or radios near a suspicious item
  • 4
    Assemble at Place Samuel de Champlain
  • 5
    Call Police: 17 (or 112) | Notify Emily Garfen: +33 6 86 31 78 71 | RSOC: +972 74-723-6000
  • 6
    Do not re-enter until Police confirm the building is clear

🛗 Elevator Emergency / Entrapment

  • 1
    Press the alarm button inside the elevator — this alerts building management directly
  • 2
    Call DALKIA (24/7): +33 6 22 17 16 91 or +33 810 804 805
  • 3
    Notify Emily Garfen: +33 6 86 31 78 71 or Julien Demouth (Site Leader)
  • 4
    Stay calm — do NOT attempt to force open the doors. Remain in the elevator until rescue is confirmed.
  • 5
    If medical assistance is needed after rescue, call SAMU: 15
✅ The elevator emergency call button was reported not working in the Jan-2023 EHS review — confirmed fixed as of 24-Aug-2026. During a fire alarm, still do NOT use the elevator — use the stairs only.

🗺️ Assembly Point — Colisée Gardens

📍 Assembly Point — Colisée Gardens: the courtyard of Parc Jacques Cartier, adjoining the Colisée Gardens building.
Address: Place Samuel de Champlain

🧯🔵🩹 Fire extinguishers, fire pull boxes (manual alarm activation — separate from a security panic button, which is confirmed not present) and the First Aid Kit are all present on the floor. ♿ Disabled persons: proceed to the freight elevator lobby and wait for assistance — do not use the passenger elevator.
🔔 Fire alarm: horn (audible) + strobe (visual).
